notes.title: Minor bugfixes
notes.content:
[b]Some minor issues are fixed. Here is the full changelog:[/b]
[list]
[*]Fixed some occasional bugs in Snake/Goat/Dragon
[*]Made the piano puzzle easier once again by disabling the black keys from the piano
[*]Fixed a bug involving the volume controls
[/list]
I'm now preparing for the game's translation. I plan to translate it to all languages known to man. If you'd like to volunteer with a language, let me know!

notes.title: Critters for Sale is the most bizarre adventure you're ever going to have
notes.content:
After the first episode being available for some time, Critters for Sale is officially released in full now and it's certainly an wild and weird experience to go through.

Read the full article here: https://www.gamingonlinux.com/2021/06/critters-for-sale-is-the-most-bizzarre-adventure-youre-ever-going-to-have

notes.title: Sharper pixels, easier Dragon piano puzzle, and other improvements
notes.content:
[b]Some small improvements have been made to the game. Here is the full changelog:[/b]
[list]
[*]Added a windowed mode toggle by pressing the F11 key. If your window suffers from blurry pixels this may be relevant to you. Windowed mode displays sharp pixels in a 1280x720 window. Good for recording GIFs and screenshots.
[*]Made Dragon's dreaded piano puzzle easier by reducing the number of piano keys considerably.
[*]Added music volume increase/decrease using F9/F10 keys
[*]Reduced mouse lag caused by the previously implemented frame rate cap
[*]Fixed some typos
[*]Added a Tips screen in the main menu with some general info that new players may not know about (mainly keyboard shortcuts)
[/list]
[i]Note: this is unlikely, but if you notice any bugs because of these changes, please let me know through my email: sonoshee.contact@gmail.com
I can't always find the time to check the Steam page here, so email is the best way to report bugs.[/i]

notes.title: Accessibility improvements
notes.content:
[b]I addressed a couple of accessibility issues some players were having. Here is the full changelog:[/b]
[list]
[*] You can now double-click on exploration areas to immediately access them. For example double-clicking a door will advance you through it without a prompt. This makes for a faster and less tedious exploration.
[*] The fast-forward button now skips dialog automatically, so it's actually practical now.
[*] Dialog speed is slightly increased. Doesn't make a big difference but it's better this way.
[*] you can earn money in the casino by pressing the + key on your keyboard. This is not the intended way to play the game, however I saw complaints from some players who just couldn't pass those mini-games. [/list]
[i]Note: this is unlikely, but if you notice any bugs because of these changes, please let me know through my email: sonoshee.contact@gmail.com
I can't always find the time to check the Steam page here, so email is the best way to report bugs.[/i]

notes.title: Minor bugfixes + frame rate cap
notes.content: Some minor issues are fixed and the application's frame rate is now capped so the GPU doesn't run at 100%

notes.title: Critters for Sale comes out June 3rd!
notes.content:
